findings.body: Each authenticated request extends the database expiry, but this cookie is issued with a 30-day Max-Age only at sign-in. An active browser therefore loses its cookie 30 days after sign-in even when the session has been used continuously. Renew the cookie as activity extends the session, and cover that behavior with an HTTP test.
findings.title: Refresh the session cookie when extending idle expiry

findings.body: The changed-email assertion signs in through `/test-auth/sign-in`, which supplies an identity directly to AccountsService. The Google HTTP test covers a new account but never signs that account in again after its email changes. Exercise the second sign-in through Google start and callback, with Google faked at its external edge, and assert that it opens the same member.
findings.title: Not done: Google account continuity end-to-end test

findings.body: Onboarding rejects every version unless a published notice exists. This change creates the table but publishes no notice; the integration test inserts one as a fixture. A real new sign-in cannot become a member until T3 supplies the approved notice.
findings.title: Later: T3 must publish a privacy notice before onboarding can complete

findings.body: This new review and task-status record is outside the permitted paths and is not needed to deliver the sign-in API, its contract, or the account-setup checklist.
findings.title: Remove the unrelated task-state file
